scramble.en: Students had to scramble to finish before the deadline.
scramble.zh: 學生們得趕緊完成，才能在截止時間前交件。

scrap.en: The art club reused each scrap of paper for collage work.
scrap.zh: 美術社把每張紙屑都重新利用來做拼貼。

scrape.en: Be careful not to scrape the table while moving the box.
scrape.zh: 搬箱子時小心不要刮到桌子。

scratch.en: The glass has a small scratch near one corner.
scratch.zh: 玻璃靠近一個角落的地方有一道小刮痕。

screw.en: A loose screw caused the chair leg to wobble slightly.
screw.zh: 一顆鬆動的螺絲讓椅腳有些搖晃。

screwdriver.en: The toolbox contains a screwdriver for basic maintenance tasks.
screwdriver.zh: 工具箱裡有一支用於基本維修的螺絲起子。

subsidize.en: The city may subsidize public transportation for certain community programs.
subsidize.zh: 市政府可能補助部分社區計畫的公共交通費用。

substance.en: The science class identified an unknown substance by observing its properties.
substance.zh: 自然科學課透過觀察性質來辨識一種未知物質。

superiority.en: The report found no clear superiority between the two study methods.
superiority.zh: 報告發現這兩種讀書方法之間沒有明顯優劣。

surgeon.en: The documentary follows a surgeon discussing teamwork in a hospital.
surgeon.zh: 紀錄片跟拍一位外科醫師談醫院中的團隊合作。

surgery.en: The article explains surgery as one type of medical treatment.
surgery.zh: 文章說明手術是醫療處置的一種類型。

surgical.en: The museum displays historical surgical instruments for educational purposes.
surgical.zh: 博物館為教育用途展示歷史外科器械。

surrender.en: The history lesson describes when the army chose to surrender.
surrender.zh: 歷史課描述那支軍隊何時選擇投降。

surveillance.en: The debate examined privacy concerns related to public surveillance systems.
surveillance.zh: 辯論探討公共監視系統所涉及的隱私問題。

survivor.en: The documentary lets a survivor describe the event in non-graphic terms.
survivor.zh: 紀錄片讓一位倖存者以非血腥方式描述事件。

suspect.en: Police identified a suspect, but the investigation was still continuing.
suspect.zh: 警方確認一名嫌疑人，但調查仍在進行。

suspend.en: The school may suspend an activity when safety conditions are uncertain.
suspend.zh: 當安全情況不明時，學校可能暫停活動。

symptom.en: The textbook defines symptom as a change noticed during illness.
symptom.zh: 課本將 symptom 定義為生病時注意到的身體變化。

syndrome.en: The article introduces syndrome as a medical term for a group of signs.
syndrome.zh: 文章介紹 syndrome 是描述一組徵象的醫學用語。

transplant.en: The health article discusses transplant medicine at a general educational level.
transplant.zh: 健康文章以一般教育程度介紹移植醫學。

trauma.en: The course discusses trauma in a general psychological context.
trauma.zh: 這門課以一般心理學脈絡討論創傷。

tumor.en: The biology textbook explains tumor growth without giving personal medical advice.
tumor.zh: 生物課本說明腫瘤生長，但不提供個人醫療建議。

vaccine.en: The article explains how a vaccine is tested before public use.
vaccine.zh: 文章說明疫苗在公開使用前如何接受測試。

vein.en: The diagram shows a major vein carrying blood toward the heart.
vein.zh: 圖表顯示一條將血液帶回心臟的主要靜脈。

virus.en: The science lesson explains how a virus differs from a bacterium.
virus.zh: 自然科學課說明病毒和細菌有何不同。

visa.en: She checked whether her visa was valid before the trip.
visa.zh: 她在旅行前確認簽證是否仍有效。

vision.en: The organization published its long-term vision for improving education.
vision.zh: 該組織公布改善教育的長期願景。

vital.en: Clean water is vital for healthy communities and ecosystems.
vital.zh: 乾淨的水對健康社區與生態系都非常重要。

vitality.en: The lively market gives the neighborhood a sense of vitality.
vitality.zh: 熱鬧的市場讓這個社區充滿活力。

vitamin.en: The nutrition lesson explains the role of each vitamin in general terms.
vitamin.zh: 營養課以一般方式說明各種維生素的作用。

vocabulary.en: Reading widely can help students expand their English vocabulary.
vocabulary.zh: 廣泛閱讀可以幫助學生擴充英文單字量。

vocal.en: She became vocal about the need for more study space.
vocal.zh: 她開始明確表達需要更多讀書空間的看法。

vocation.en: He viewed teaching as both a career and a vocation.
vocation.zh: 他把教學視為職業，也視為一種志業。

vocational.en: The school offers vocational courses in design and technology.
vocational.zh: 學校提供設計與科技方面的職業課程。

volcano.en: The class built a model to show the shape of a volcano.
volcano.zh: 班上做了一個模型來展示火山的形狀。

volleyball.en: The students played volleyball during the afternoon sports period.
volleyball.zh: 學生在下午體育課打排球。

vomit.en: The health textbook lists vomit as a word used in medical descriptions.
vomit.zh: 健康課本將 vomit 列為醫療描述中使用的字詞。

voter.en: Each voter in the mock election received one ballot.
voter.zh: 模擬選舉中的每位選民都拿到一張選票。

voucher.en: The library gave each winner a bookstore voucher.
voucher.zh: 圖書館給每位得獎者一張書店禮券。

vow.en: She made a vow to finish the project responsibly.
vow.zh: 她立下承諾，要負責任地完成這個專題。

vowel.en: The teacher asked students to identify each vowel in the word.
vowel.zh: 老師請學生找出單字中的每個母音。

voyage.en: The novel follows a long voyage across the Pacific Ocean.
voyage.zh: 小說描寫一次橫越太平洋的長途航行。

vulnerable.en: Young plants are vulnerable to sudden changes in temperature.
vulnerable.zh: 幼苗容易受到突然溫度變化的影響。

wag.en: The dog began to wag its tail when the family returned.
wag.zh: 家人回來時，那隻狗開始搖尾巴。

wage.en: The report compares the average wage across several industries.
wage.zh: 報告比較數個產業的平均工資。

wagon.en: The old wagon is now displayed inside the local museum.
wagon.zh: 那輛老馬車現在展示在地方博物館裡。

waiter.en: The waiter brought the menu and answered questions about the dishes.
waiter.zh: 服務生送上菜單並回答關於餐點的問題。

behold.en: Visitors stopped to behold the wide mountain view from the platform.
behold.zh: 遊客停下腳步欣賞觀景台上的遼闊山景。

bestseller.en: The novel became a bestseller soon after its translation appeared.
bestseller.zh: 這本小說的譯本推出後不久便成為暢銷書。

bewilder.en: Too many conflicting instructions can bewilder new users.
bewilder.zh: 太多互相矛盾的指示可能讓新使用者感到困惑。
